description: Header file defining internal functions and configurations for ARC architecture's Memory Protection Unit (MPU), including enabling/disabling MPU, configuring regions, and handling user space memory partitions.

methods.name: arc_core_mpu_enable
methods.description: Enables the MPU by setting the enable bit in the MPU control register.

methods.name: arc_core_mpu_disable
methods.description: Disables the MPU by clearing the enable bit in the MPU control register.

methods.name: arc_core_mpu_configure_thread
methods.description: Configures MPU regions for a given thread, including user stack if applicable.

methods.name: arc_core_mpu_default
methods.description: Sets the default region attribute for the MPU.

methods.name: arc_core_mpu_region
methods.description: Configures a specific MPU region with base address, size, and attributes.

methods.name: arc_core_mpu_configure_mem_domain
methods.description: Configures MPU regions for the memory partitions of a thread's memory domain.

methods.name: arc_core_mpu_remove_mem_domain
methods.description: Removes MPU regions associated with a memory domain.

methods.name: arc_core_mpu_remove_mem_partition
methods.description: Resets a specific memory partition's MPU region.

methods.name: arc_core_mpu_get_max_domain_partition_regions
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of regions available for memory domain partitions.

methods.name: arc_core_mpu_buffer_validate
methods.description: Validates if a buffer is accessible for user space, considering permissions.

methods.name: arc_mpu_init
methods.description: Initializes the MPU with default and static regions during system startup.
